Ana: Quick final gate for Sundial private/VPC onboarding. Remaining items: peering acceptance, KMS alias + rotation, short-lived CloudTrail bucket access. Can we finish today?
Mike: I have networking. VPC = 10.44.0.0/16, peer = 10.54.0.0/16. No overlap. I'll send peering request now.
Sam: On KMS: customer wants CMK in their account, alias prefixed `sundial/`, auto-rotate yearly. Need exact key ARN to update our decrypt role.
Priya: They also asked for CloudTrail -> central bucket path and 48h read-only for our onboarding role. I'll draft the bucket policy and post it.
Mike: Peering request sent; waiting for their accept. I included a terraform snippet in the doc.
Sam: When you have the ARN, paste here and I'll attach the minimal key policy (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey for `role/redwood-ingest`).
Ana: Customer posted ARN: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:112233445566:key/ff11aa22bb33`. Sam, please proceed.
Priya: Drafted bucket policy for 48h access and pinned it in the ticket. Using short expiry role session via STS.
DeployBot: preflight: network=waiting_peering, kms=policy_missing, cloudtrail=policy_proposed. Link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/checks/3090001111
Sam: Policy attached and rotation flagged. Left note for least-privilege role name.
Mike: Peering accepted by customer. I'll apply routes and NAT rules tonight at 18:00 UTC.
Priya: SIEM team confirmed subscription config. I'll hand over the endpoint to customer ops.
Ana: Action list: Mike -> apply terraform at cutover; Sam -> confirm KMS policy applied; Priya -> verify bucket access window; Ana -> monitor preflight and runbook. Also flagged renewal risk: customer asked about committed Dedicated pricing if they exceed pilot. Logged for AE follow-up.
Mike: Ready to apply when DeployBot shows kms=ok.
DeployBot: post-update: network=ok, kms=ok, cloudtrail=ok. All checks passed.
Ana: Great work team :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and schedule the 1h pre-cutover ops-bridge.
